description: This file defines the login and registration page component for a Remix-based React application, including loader and action functions for server-side logic, session management, and client-side form rendering.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Server-side loader function that redirects authenticated users away from the login page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Server-side action function that handles login and registration submissions, manages sessions, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React component rendering the login/register form, handling UI state and navigation links.
